_source: Miami-Dade Water and Sewer Department (MDWASD) 'Water and Sewer Design & Construction Standards' -- https://www.miamidade.gov/global/service.page?Mduid_service=ser148156625339722 . Read 2026-10-02: UC-005 (Project Approval, R-7 2/2015), Standard Details GS 0.5, GS 1.5 (10/1/2017), WS 2.21 sheets 1-3, UC-250, UC-310, UC-075. These are the county-wide (government) rules: they govern BOTH existing/current data cleanup AND design proposals. Where a rule says 'proposed', it is the design rule; for Fase 1 (existing conditions only) the same numbers are used to LABEL / CHECK what exists, never to draw design.
_howToUse: scripts/mdwasd-check.mjs reads this file; fase1-qc.py calls it; c300-mdwasd-easement.mjs draws the easement for mains that sit on private property. Never edit a number here without the section it came from. Source of truth = the PDFs; if MDWASD revises a section (check the revision stamp on the page), update the value + 'rev' here and in plugin src/standards/data/mdwasd_rules.json.

easements.noStructuresOrTrees: none inside the easement incl. its vertical projection; overhead utilities/structures only with >= 25 ft clearance (A.9)
easements.accessoriesOutside: meters, fire hydrants and other MDWASD accessories go OUTSIDE the main easement with their own separate easement (A.11); in private property the meters are part of an MDWASD easement (B.5)
easements.stripDerivedFromThisFile: easement = centerline offset +/- offsetEachSide; the strip is drawn on C-ANNO as DASHED2 polylines (same recipe as c300-easement.mjs)
easements.platUE: A recorded-plat utility easement (U.E., e.g. 5 ft on a lot line) is NOT an MDWASD easement: it keeps coming from the plat + user confirmation (c300-easement.mjs). MDWASD easements apply only to mains on private property.

waterToGravitySewer.note: 6 ft only where the water main is >= 6 in above the top of the gravity sewer (note 3); else 10 ft wall to wall

waterToStormOrReclaimed.storm10ftNote: 10 ft wall to wall preferred between potable and storm/wastewater/force (note 2)

otherUtilityOrDrainageFace2Face.note: any water/sewer main to any utility or drainage not covered by 62-555.314 (UC-005 A.16)

separation.crossingNote: water main above sewer: 12 in (invert of upper to crown of lower); if not possible, DIP both, joints equidistant (>= 10 ft between joints), 6 in min. Laterals/services: 12 in, else 20 ft DIP WM centered / 10 ft PVC casing for services. Cross perpendicular whenever possible.

manholeShows: rim elevation on top of the manhole
sewer.terminalManholeSlopeRule: 0.4% to compute the depth (pump station sites)

coverGrassAreas.between2_5and6: DIP, or C900 PVC (SDR35 under a non-reinforced slab) if approved
coverGrassAreas.between6and14: PVC OK if approved, no slab

coverPaved.lt3_5: DIP or C900 PVC if approved

sewer.lateral: branch fitting = tee w/ modified riser when sewer top >= 7 ft deep, else wye (SS 1.0/2.0); plug at the point shown; green-painted 2x2x2 ft stake at the lateral end; location measured and recorded before covering (UC-310 3.01)

water.valveSpacingNote: resilient-seat gate valves every 660 ft; butterfly same for >= 42 in; transmission >= 20 in: valve every 1/2 mile

fireHydrantLateral.assembly: 6 in M.J. tee/tapping sleeve + 6 in gate valve + 6 in DIP (WS 4.50)

coverMinIn.note: less cover than this => reinforced concrete slab (GS 1.2)

water.servicePipe: 1-in and 2-in HDPE (blue, tracer wire) per UC-075; services <= 2 in from existing mains are made by MDWASD forces at owner expense; cutting/plugging existing MDWASD mains likewise

drawingConventions.existingMain: broken (dashed) line; proposed = dark solid; both labeled with size + material; >= 20 in drawn double line
drawingConventions.tappingSleeve: offset to nearest KNOWN centerline/baseline + size and material of the pipe tapped
drawingConventions.planScale: 1 in = 10 ft to 1 in = 40 ft; profile vertical = 1/10 of plan
drawingConventions.locationSketch: 1 in = 300 ft on the first sheet
drawingConventions.standardNotes: GS 0.5 notes must be on all water and sewer plans; other notes 'Not Part of MDWASD Notes nor Approval' or on a separate sheet
profile: top elevation of other crossing utilities

format: CADD (DWG/DXF) rotated and translated to NAD83 Florida East State Plane
words RECORD DRAWING in large letters
title block with Department DS/DW/ER number
separate drawings and profiles for water and sewer
stationing starts 0+00 at a permanent reference point (CL etc.) and runs continuously to the end of main
easements tied to the permanent reference point
all control lines identified (building line, property line, R/W)
all PROPOSED information removed, only record information remains
waterMustInclude: station of services, hydrants, valves, fittings (State Plane coordinates)
profile: top of ground + top of pipe every 100 ft and at grade changes
sewerMustInclude: location of laterals referenced to manhole + cleanouts
N/E coordinates on all field measurements
profile: MH number, RIM and INV (label N/S/E/W if more than one invert), station from 0+00 at the downstream MH
recordDrawings.coordinates: State Plane coordinates of ALL manholes and valves + at least two horizontal control points
recordDrawings.usedBy: asbuilt-review.py required fields (MH: number, RIM, INV by direction; main: size, material, slope; appurtenance: station/offset); fase1-qc.py completeness; Fase 1 existing labels

fase1Policy.existingOnly: Fase 1 labels EXISTING facilities (with size, material, slope, RIM/INV, '(TO REMAIN)') -- no design wording; the MDWASD numbers are used here only to CHECK that what exists is shown consistently (separations, MH spacing, easement presence) and to WARN, never to alter measured as-built values.
fase1Policy.easementOnExistingMains: If an existing WASD main lies on private property (outside the public R/W), the recorded MDWASD easement (or the standard strip above if the recorded width is not available) must be shown with the label of A.8. If the main is in the public R/W, no MDWASD easement is drawn.
fase1Policy.neverInventValues: A width taken from this file is a STANDARD, not a project measurement: when the recorded easement differs, the recorded value (user-confirmed) wins.

designPolicy.useFor: Propuesta (design) work: place mains/MHs/valves/hydrants so these numbers hold; easement strips per 'easements'; accessories outside the easement; label per 'drawingConventions'; run scripts/mdwasd-check.mjs on the design as-built-shaped JSON before delivering.

cadManual.source: WASD Pipeline CAD and GIS Standards Manual, January 2026 (https://www.miamidade.gov/resources/water/documents/wasd-cad-manual.pdf); WASD CAD Manager Eric Vilaire, Eric.Vilaire@miamidade.gov, 305-878-6051. The edition used by repo docs/reference/wasd-symbol-legend.md is June 2024.
cadManual.software: Civil 3D 2025 / AutoCAD 2025; submit DWG + PDF (PDF made from AutoCAD, with layers)

datum.modelScale: 1:1 in model space; the viewport sets the plot scale

text.note: center-left justification for blocks of text; no unusually large text

annotationRules: move annotation away from the feature
avoid odd abbreviations and squeezed text
group leaders at about the same angle

numbers.stationing: continuous 100-ft stations, start 10+00 at an intersection (9+50 behind it), west->east or south->north
numbers.statePlaneCoordsAt: start, end, PIs, PCs, PTs and major appurtenances (manhole, cleanout, access device)

scales.profileVertical: 1in=2ft (major lines every 4 ft); 1in=4ft only with WASD approval

sheet.dwgNumber: W (water) / S (sewer) + D (D-size), assigned by the WASD PM

cadManual.calloutTable371: BEGIN/END PROJECT STA. XX+XX (O/S XX' RT./LT.) PROP. ...; bends PROP. XX"-90 M.J. BEND REST. W/GLANDS; plugs/caps PROP. XX" M.J. PLUG W/F.V.O.; hydrants PROP. XX"x6" M.J. TEE, 6" M.J. GATE VALVE & F.H. ASSY. SEE STANDARD DETAIL WS 4.50; meters PROP. 1" SERVICE AND [SINGLE/DOUBLE] METER BOX (SEE STD. DETAIL WS 2.10)
cadManual.surveyCalloutTable372: manholes: MHSA / RIM ELEV.=X.XX' / 8" CLAY (E) INV. ELEV.=X.XX' / BOTTOM ELEV.=X.XX'; reference points: RP #1 SET PK W/WASD STA.= O/S= N= E= ELEV.=; baseline: BEGIN BASELINE X STA= N= E=

layersExistingPipeline.convention: US NCS: Discipline_Major_Minor1_Minor2; design layers C-*, survey layers V-*

surveyExisting.rowAndProperty: V-RWAY color 20 PHANTOM2; V-PROP-LINE 253 PHANTOM2; V-PROP-LOTL 254 HIDDEN2; V-ROAD-CNTR 6 CENTER2; V-ROAD-BASL 211

layersExistingPipeline.planViewLineStyles: existing water main = HIDDEN color 190 0.006in; proposed = CONTINUOUS color 171 0.012in (width 0.5); existing sewer HIDDEN 70; proposed 90; pipes >= 20 in = two lines + dashed centerline; abandoned = WASD_ABANDONED_LINE

cadManual.gisAsBuiltLayers: Appendix A.3: plan-view as-built pipeline assets only, layer suffix _WASD (WDistribution_WASD, WServiceLine_WASD, WFireLine_WASD, WManualControlValve_WASD, WHydrant_WASD, WServicePointConnection_WASD, WFitting_WASD, WAccessManhole_WASD, SGravityMain_WASD, SForceMain_WASD, SSewerLateral_WASD, SManhole_WASD, SCleanOut_WASD, SManualControlValve_WASD, SAirReleaseValve_WASD, SFitting_WASD, LPS*) with subtype prefixes (Tee_WFitting_WASD, Bend_SFitting_WASD, Gate_WManualControlValve_WASD). Not for design or survey drafting.

asBuiltChapter7.pipes: single-line line/polyline, basepoint to basepoint, one polyline per uniform diameter/material
asBuiltChapter7.points: blocks / COGO points at the surveyed basepoint; lines snap to block basepoints
asBuiltChapter7.content: only field-verified installed assets; no trees, signs, poles, mailboxes, spot elevations, no lot lines/EOP; existing utilities only where they cross/conflict; no proposed/design info; as-built pipes, property lines, R/W, easements and baselines bold (WASD lineweights), everything else faded
asBuiltChapter7.attributes: Appendix C: pipes CASING/DIAMETER/MATERIAL/FACILDESC/INSTALLDATE; fittings COMMENTS/FACILDESC/X/Y; valves VALVESIZE/FACILDESC/INSTALLDATE/X/Y; structures INSTALLDATE/X/Y; appurtenances DIAMETER/FACILDESC/INSTALLDATE/X/Y
asBuiltChapter7.fileNaming: E (water) / ES (sewer) + 6-digit as-built number + C/D (Capital/Donation) + 2-digit phase + sub-phase letter, e.g. EXXXXXXC01A; governing procedure SOP-SRS-007
asBuiltChapter7.templates: WASDTemplate-Survey-Asbuilts.dwt, WASDTemplate-Pipeline-Design.dwt, WASD-Blocks.dwg (read-only, from the WASD website). The links the county page lists (.../donation/part-6/wasdtemplate-survey-asbuilts.dwt and pipeline-design-consultant-template.dwt) return HTTP 404 as of 2026-10-02 with every host/case/header variant: get them from the WASD CAD Manager or from the copy the firm already has.

cadManual.symbolsGS30: GS 3.0 legend (2009/2016): existing = thin/gray open symbols; proposed = bold/solid. Gate and plug valve existing = open bowtie, proposed = filled bowtie; plug = open/filled triangle; fire hydrant (existing open, proposed filled); tapping sleeve and valve; backflow preventer; check valve = N-shape; bends 90 = L-shape; pipes >= 20 in = double line; lines: R/W, P (property), CL, baseline (BL), EOP dashed. Exhibits A.1-A.8 / B.1-B.3 / C.1-C.2 / D.1-D.4 are the same in the 2026 edition as in the 2024 transcription (repo docs/reference/wasd-symbol-legend.md); 2026 adds V-PNTS-LABL-* layers, the lot-line layer V-PROP-LOTL, survey lineweights (grey xref plot) and wipeout frames on blocks.

WS 4.50 (02/25/2013) fire hydrant with g.lateral: 6 in D.I. pipe from a M.J. tee or tapping sleeve + 6 in gate valve (or tapping valve) in a No. 2 valve box; 6 in D.I. nipple 18 in long
WS 4.50 (02/25/2013) fire hydrant with g.cover: 4 ft (bury depth 54 in to the hydrant shoe), 18 in x 18 in concrete thrust block (no mechanical restraint on the shoe)
WS 4.50 (02/25/2013) fire hydrant with g.slab: 3 ft x 3 ft x 6 in thick concrete slab or sidewalk flag; where a sidewalk is within the 4-7 ft offset, hydrant 1 ft from the face of the walk, within the grass area; otherwise the Fire Department decides the location
WS 4.50 (02/25/2013) fire hydrant with g.guardPosts: galvanized steel pipe 4 in dia x 5 ft (2.5 ft buried, concrete filled) at the face of the pumper and 2 ft 6 in left/right of the hydrant CL; none inside F.D.O.T. R/W; not within a radius

WS 4.10 (11/01/2006) typical service pla.meterBox: single or dual meter box, center line of box 2.5 ft inside the property line; meters are NOT installed if the box falls in a driving surface
WS 4.10 (11/01/2006) typical service pla.service: 1 in copper tubing; road crossing in 1-1/2 in black steel casing with an 18 in minimum offset; 2 in x 4 in meter vault for 2 in service (2 in G.I. customer side)

SS 1.0 (08/26/2010) gravity sewer servic.lateral: 6 in minimum (larger as required), minimum slope 1/8 in per ft downward from the main; wye + 45 degree bends (tee with modified riser for deeper sewers, SS 2.0); main 8 in minimum
SS 1.0 (08/26/2010) gravity sewer servic.invert: 3 ft minimum to invert (deeper as required)
SS 1.0 (08/26/2010) gravity sewer servic.cleanout: clean-out with threaded plug in a concrete box + lid in the sidewalk flag (grass: SS 21.0), at the property line / ultimate R/W line / utility easement line; watertight plug at the lateral end (removed later with a PVC hard coupling by others)

detailsIndex._doc: Key numbers read from the standard-detail images (all re-checked against the images 2026-10-02; full text per detail: references/mdwasd-details.md).

manhole_SS6_SS7.inletHoleDiameter: pipe OD + 4 in (14 in hole for 8 in pipe with 6 in grout)

No2.use: fire hydrant valves, fire line and domestic services, 2 in mains in easements, bypass valves

trench.bedding: 6 in under pipe; select backfill 90% 12 in over crown; rest 98%; PVC water: #57 stone or pea rock
trench.encasement: polyethylene >= 8 mil if the Department requires (A 9.0)

hydrant_WS4_50.guardPost: 4 in x 5 ft Sch.40, 2.5 ft each side of CL at the pumper face, none in FDOT R/W

meterBank_WS4_16.header2in: max 10 x 5/8 in or 5 x 1 in

airRelease_WS1_60_SS11.valve: 2 in stainless ball valve, 1.5x2 corp stop

pavementRestoration.A1.0_typeI: 2 in asphalt over 8 in base, +12 in each side
pavementRestoration.A1.2_typeII: surface = ditch W + 4 ft, asphalt >= 3 in, Superpave 12.5
pavementRestoration.A4.0_typeM: asphalt = adjacent road or 1.5 in, base 12 in

detailsIndex.preconstruction: call MDWASD inspection 2 full business days before; One Call 48 h before digging

separationJointSpacingAtCrossings_GS1_5.stormOrVacuum: 3 ft min alternate (full length of pipe centered)

symbols_GS3_0.tappingSleeveAndValve: hydrant-like symbol over a double line
symbols_GS3_0.lines: section line S, R/W, P (property), CL, BL (base line), EOP dashed
